summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.77/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.77 a gallon across Wisconsin as of August 10, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 11¢ lower than a week ago, 26¢ higher than a month ago, and 97¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.58) and the highest in Superior ($4.00).
